behaviors.behavior: The added workflow keeps the action-pinning posture: only GitHub-owned actions on mutable tags, no third-party action, no hosted updater (CLAUDE.md rule 25).
behaviors.evidence: server/src/test/ci-action-pinning-posture.test.ts — 10/10 PASSED against the tree containing .github/workflows/publish-npm.yml (both drift directions).

behaviors.behavior: The workflow YAML is well-formed and parses.
behaviors.evidence: python yaml.safe_load of .github/workflows/publish-npm.yml succeeds ('YAML OK'); the posture test also loads/parses every workflow file in .github/workflows/.

behaviors.behavior: A pushed tag whose version disagrees with bootstrapper/package.json, or is a prerelease, or is already published on npm, fails the guard fast before any build/publish.
behaviors.reason: The guard step runs only inside GitHub Actions (GITHUB_REF_NAME) and its already-published check calls the live npm registry (npm view); neither is reproducible in this repo's CI.

behaviors.behavior: On a matching stable tag, the job builds server+client+bootstrapper, verifies the tarball assembles with non-empty dist, and publishes to npm via OIDC trusted publishing (no NPM_TOKEN, provenance automatic).
behaviors.reason: Requires the GitHub Actions OIDC identity and a live npm publish against @svenroth-ai/shipwright — an irreversible external side effect that cannot run in CI; first exercised by the next real release tag.

surface_verification.justification: No web or CLI surface. The change is a single GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml) with no client or server runtime code, so there is nothing to render or drive in a browser. Structural verification (YAML parse + ci-action-pinning-posture 10/10) and the full internal review cascade (spec/code/doubt) plus the PR-Review CI gate stand in for a surface run.
